feedback_eligibility: end_ms and actual released_ms strictly before query start

plan.stopping_rule: First20events by actual CN start after registration; upstream complete event inventory required to audit inclusion, including events without forecasts.
plan.sample_size_basis: Feasibility budget; no claim of powered superiority test. All interim reports descriptive; no candidate changes by observed future scores.

terminal_window.verification_owner: trusted upstream collector; retain raw source hash and observation timestamp

plan.comparisons_fixed_before_new_test_score: Three candidates were specified in PI-to-C design messages before independent new scoring; no test-min replacement.
plan.dlm_parameters: Use fixed_replay_v2/frozen_dlm_parameters.json complete training35 parameters; update state from released history, never refit Q/R on held-out outcomes.
plan.data_arrival: Historical export requires actual released_ms strictly before query start, as well as event end.
plan.integration_scope: Append-only submission, release, export and scoring interface. Upstream data acquisition, candidate prediction execution and population completeness require separate verified integration.
plan.coverage: Physical(event,rank,cutoff) dedup; all methods same cases; frozen grids and issue lag enforced. Missing planned observations and upstream exclusions must be reported.

limits: Method identifiers are recorded commitments; forecasting is an upstream step.
Verified outcome capture provenance is supplied by the trusted collector.
No new activity outcome or prospective accuracy exists at registration.
